question: Who among the following published a set of Ashokan inscriptions in the year 1877?
solution: The correct answer is **__Alexander Cunningham.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Alexander Cunningham is known as** the father of the Archaeological Survey of India.** • Cunningham was the first to **excavate Sarnath (Varanasi)**.
